ref: agentlint tests: TL-B5 claude-session-jsonl negative case, isSidechain records without an agentId
format_version_note: Hand-written; models older inline-sidechain layouts where subagent records sit in the parent file with no agentId. The 'version' value 2.1.0 is a placeholder.
notes: The loader has no original identifier to key a separate run on, so it must leave the sidechain records out, mark the parent run incomplete with reason sidechain_without_agent_id, and never merge them into the parent run as sequential events.
